column2: CO2 emissions = energy combustion related and industrial process CO2 emissions.

GHG emissions = Energy sector greenhouse gas (GHG) emissions, including energy-related combustion, industrial process and flared CO2 emissions plus combustion, fugitive, flared and vented methane (CH4) and nitrous oxide (N2O) emissions from the energy and industry sectors.
CO2 emissions from international marine and aviation bunkers are included only at the World level.
Rounding may lead to minor differences between totals and the sum of their individual components.
